definitions.explanation: Smiling in a knowing, often mischievous or self-satisfied way.

examples.japanese: にやにやし⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He's talking with a grin on his face.

examples.japanese: にやにや⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち{悪|わる}い→気持ち悪い：07154_kimochiwarui⟧。

⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧にやにやして⟦いたら→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んでる→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧？」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}かれた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: When I was grinning while looking at my phone, my friend asked, "What are you reading?"

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧にやにや⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{答|こた}えなかった→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。
examples.english: He just kept smirking and didn't answer anything.

notes:
にやにや is a mimetic word describing a sly, knowing, or self-satisfied smile.

USAGE:
- にやにやする: to grin, to smirk
- にやにや⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧: to smirk
- にやにやし⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧: while smirking
Often carries negative or suspicious connotations - the person seems to know something others don't, or appears self-satisfied in an off-putting way.

CONTRAST WITH SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦にこにこ→にこにこ：05177_nikoniko⟧: smiling pleasantly, warmly (positive)
- ⟦にたにた→にたにた：05935_nitanita⟧: grinning unpleasantly (more negative than にやにや)
- ⟦にっこり→にっこり：03517_nikkori⟧: giving a single bright smile (positive, momentary)
- ⟦にんまり→にんまり：29117_ninmari⟧: grinning with satisfaction (can be positive or negative)

EXAMPLE CONTEXT:
⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧にやにやして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧？ is often said when someone's smirk seems suspicious or annoying.
